site_coordinates.definition: IAU Gazetteer Feature 5450, center solution 1 (planetographic, +East, -180 to 180). This is the Shackleton crater center, not a rim point or an official Artemis landing-site coordinate. DEM frame compatibility with MOON_ME remains pending M2 confirmation.

warnings: PRELIMINARY: coordinates are IAU Gazetteer feature centers, not independently verified Artemis region centers or landing points.
PRELIMINARY: DEM horizon frame is not confirmed compatible with the M2 MOON_ME ephemeris frame.
